# Sajha Kaam · साझा काम: animatic shot list

1920×1080, 30 fps.

**Timing.** `src/lib/voTiming.ts`, generated by `python scripts/vo-table.py` from VOICEOVER.md, is the single source of timing.
- Each story beat lasts exactly as long as its narration paragraph.
- The beat's shots are time-remapped to fill it (`FittedShots` in `src/scenes/story/Story.tsx`).
- Until real audio exists, durations are estimates (words / 2.6 + 2 s pause).
- After recording, run `python scripts/vo-table.py --measure`. It splits `public/vo/story.m4a` and `public/vo/demo.m4a` on the 2 s pauses.
- `public/vo/story.m4a` plays automatically when it is present.

**Look.**
- Light set (a), with flat off-white and drifting app-tint colour fields, plus a 3% Dhaka-weave accent (`BgCtx` in `src/lib/paint.tsx`).
- The app's colour tokens (`src/lib/theme.ts`).
- Fonts: Bricolage Grotesque for headings, Figtree for small text, Anek Devanagari for Nepali.

**Tools.**
- Rough.js: linework, with line boil at 7.5 Hz.
- Paper.js: the path-aligned Dhaka thread band.
- Zdog: the 3D coins and badge stars.
- p5 noise: coin flow and the net weaving.
- p5.brush: pre-rendered watercolour blooms in `public/brush`, used by background option (d).
- All randomness is seeded.

**Model sheet.** Every person comes from the single `Character` component, with poses and expressions as props:
- Emma, Rajan, Sita, Bikash
- Pemba, Anusha
- extras

**Screen direction.** Melbourne is on the left, Nepal on the right, and the thread runs left → right.

**Transitions.** Panel slides ("SC n · SH n" borders) between beats, a page flip into beats 6 and 13, and straight cuts within beats.

## SajhaKaamStory: 13 beats, 160.7 s (estimate)

| # | Beat | Starts | Shots | On-screen words |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The gap | 0:00 | Sita's screen pulls back to her at her desk (Pokhara) → Bikash filming the stupa (Kathmandu) → **hold** on Sita reading "Experience required" → Bikash at the shop door with empty pockets → **NEW** departure gate: a queue with suitcases walks out, a plane takes off, and a counter ticks to 200,000 / year | Kathmandu, Experience required, 200,000 / year |
| 2 | The other side | 0:18.5 | Melbourne establishing → Emma's thought bubbles (page, video, faceless stranger "?") → **NEW** Emma hands Rajan his coffee with a smile (a small heart) → Rajan's calendar overflows | Melbourne |
| 3 | The solution | 0:35.1 | Rajan opens the app → the thread draws Melbourne → Pokhara → Kathmandu → "Team Leader" tag while work folders travel the thread home | Team Leader |
| 4 | A Leader brings the client | 0:46.4 | Generic chat: the link bubble flies from Rajan's phone to Emma's, then she taps it and the app opens with the job waiting | (none) |
| 5 | Or the client posts it | 0:55.7 | Emma pins a job; two Leaders with green ✓ shields step up; an unverified one is greyed at a gate ("verified only"); Emma chooses Rajan (ring) | verified only |
| 6 | The agreement | 1:06.1 | Paper agreement (deliverables, "finished when" ticks, deadline, budget) → both thumbs tap Agree → the padlock drops → coins arc into the held jar, which locks | Agree |
| 7 | The team | 1:18.1 | Notification banners drop on Sita's and Bikash's phones → share cards "50%", tap "Ask to join" → Rajan's ✓ stamp | 50%, Ask to join |
| 8 | Guidance and feedback | 1:29.4 | The job room: tasks tick, uploads fill, Rajan's pencil circles one detail (he guides, he doesn't do), Sita sends v2 (the hero becomes latte art), the quality line rises, then the **Approved** stamp | Approved |
| 9 | First pay | 1:42.9 | Emma taps ✓, the jar opens and coins stream home → **hold** on Sita and Bikash catching their first pay → the coin splits: 15% (always), member 50 → 80% as the badge grows, the Leader's share with a guiding hand | 15%, 50→80%, 35→5% |
| 10 | Proof | 1:58.4 | Work Record: the stamp slams (shake), entries are verified, the badge star turns in 3D → Sita holds her record up and every ✗ on the notice board becomes ✓ | Work Record, Verified |
| 11 | The journey | 2:07.3 | Star staircase (the public-rule chips light before each hop) → Fair play card: lower or pause only, with a reason the member sees; a third beginner is blocked | Fair play, 2 |
| 12 | From member to Leader | 2:19.3 | The Mentor on her verified stack becomes a Leader (shield); a newcomer is verified by the reviewer → the thread becomes a woven net with new people joining | Leader, Verified |
| 13 | Opportunity comes home | 2:30.2 | **NEW** mirror of beat 1: Sita and Bikash at home on laptops, the net glowing over Nepal, a plane flies **in** and drops work folders → end card with the four portraits on the thread | Sajha Kaam · साझा काम |

## SajhaKaamDemo
Built from `public/demo/manifest.json` plus `public/demo-plan.json`. The plan is keyed by each step's line, so renumbered clips still match.
- Order: intro card → chapters (taken from the manifest's `chapter` field when present) → close card.
- Each chapter's length is at least its narration from `DEMO_VO`. Its slice of `public/vo/demo.m4a` starts with it, so the voice stays in sync even when the pictures run longer.
- Steps:
  - one hand-drawn phone per step, with the character beside it
  - pairs shown side by side, the active one playing and the other frozen
  - pans between items
  - typing sped up 1.2–1.8×
- Inserts: invite, open, notify, release, sms.
